targets.old_statement: Speed limit signs set a maximum that applies in ideal conditions, so they are not a guarantee that the posted speed is safe at every moment.

targets.statement: Speed limit signs are black-and-white signs showing the maximum legal speed allowed under ideal conditions.

targets.old_statement: Guide signs, in green, brown or blue, give information and directions rather than stating laws to obey.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Guide signs, in green, brown or blue, give information and directions rather than stating laws to obey.
targets.statement: Guide signs are square or rectangular signs in green, brown, or blue that give intersecting-road information, directions to cities and towns, points of interest, and locations of hospitals, service stations, restaurants, and hotels.
